{{Top|canon=Ettel Nuts}}
'''Ettel nuts''' were edible nuts that could be crushed into a paste to make [[nutmeat]]. They were also used as an ingredient in [[iced donut with chopped ettel nuts]], which was served in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
